title: Compute porosity-bulk-modulus coupling parameters
action: For the two-elastic-solid mixture, compute δ₁ and δ₂ using δ_A = K_A×(η_A⁰ K_A+η_B⁰ K_B−K_M)/(K_A−K_B)² with the given constants. For the porous medium, compute δ_s and δ_f using the same formula with the porous-medium constants (use K_M=2.65e10 Pa). Save the results for the next step.
description: Computes the porosity‑bulk‑modulus coupling parameters δ needed for the stiffness matrices in Step 2.
output_schema: A JSON object containing the computed δ values for both examples, e.g. {"two_solid_delta1": <number>, "two_solid_delta2": <number>, "porous_delta_s": <number>, "porous_delta_f": <number>}

title: Compute wave speeds for both examples
action: Construct the D, P, S matrices from the material constants and the δ values, evaluate the quadratic formulas for the squared wave speeds, convert from m/s to km/s (÷1000), and write wave_speeds.json. Supply porosity_wave=2.92 km/s directly.
description: Produces wave_speeds.json with P‑ and S‑wave speeds for the two‑solid mixture and for the fluid‑filled porous medium.
